assessments.reasoning: The shift overview says omitted indices default to zero. Its nested x-y-x examples show that an explicit counter skips differently named bindings.

challenge.method: Compare x@0, x@1 and the unindexed x with the arrows across the intervening y binder.
challenge.results: Unindexed x points to the same innermost matching binder as x@0. The x@1 example selects outward across y, rejecting absolute stack offsets for the named case.

limitations: The statement concerns omitted indexing at a variable reference and leaves free-variable and name-resolution failure outcomes outside its scope.
